children: Overview
US maritime tech firm's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 44% yr/yr to $1.7 mln
Company posted a net loss of $10.5 mln, with loss per share unchanged yr/yr
Backlog and sales pipeline grew, but gross loss widened on strategic investments
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods
Result Drivers
DEFENSE CONTRACTS - Largest deployment and recurring revenue contract in co's history supported by PowerBuoy systems for DHS maritime operations
TECHNOLOGY INVESTMENTS - Gross loss widened due to investments in strategic customer programs and technology development, including contracts accepted to establish long-term relationships
PORTFOLIO EXPANSION - Acquisition of subsea technology assets from Columbia Power Technologies extended operational infrastructure capabilities
